amendment_note: Amended before commit, inside the same attempt, to record a defect this attempt introduced and corrected: re-running the normalization unbound 30 closed predicates owned by MD-B08, MD-B09 and MD-B10. title: Credential masking bound as an executable MD-B07 predicate at 116/116, and the normalization scope defect that hid it closed
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE — MD-S066-R0002 is promoted, bound, and proven; the B07 denominator is 116/116 with zero unbound; no application source, schema, configuration, or storage was changed.
authority_basis: MD-S066 Credentials and Secrets Contract: 'Mask tokens/cookies/keys.' — the second of exactly two imperative sentences in a four-line LOCKED contract.
MD-S053 Immutable observation envelope (LOCKED): 'Credential, API key, cookie rahasia, authorization header, dan sensitive query value tidak boleh masuk envelope atau diagnostic sample.'
STRATEGY_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_STANDARD.md section 8.4: proof-owning-stage assignment must be confirmed for the stage, which a pass that reviews a self-selected subset does not satisfy.
STRATEGY_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_STANDARD.md section 9: correcting a classification defect is permitted without a strategy byte change when strategy meaning is unchanged.

defect_corrected.prior_state: REFERENCE_ONLY / REFERENCE_ONLY / REFERENCE_ONLY with empty notes
defect_corrected.corrected_state: REQUIRED / MANDATORY / SATISFIED bound to E-MD-B07-A002-001
defect_corrected.why_prior_was_defective: MD-S066-R0001 and MD-S066-R0002 are adjacent imperative sentences in one four-line contract. R0001 was bound as a mandatory predicate with a full proof chain; R0002 was filed as reference context. The two are indistinguishable in form, subject, and enforceability.
defect_corrected.mechanism: MarketDataSourceAcquisitionNormalization.php selected its scope from SOURCE_DOCUMENT_COUNTS (MD-S053, MD-S054) plus a hand-curated EXTERNAL_RULES list of eight rules, and any B07-owned row in neither list hit an unguarded continue. The two lists covered 166 of 167 B07-owned rows; nothing in the pass could report the omission.
defect_corrected.detectability_before: None. The classification consistency gate reports MIXED_RUN only for enumerated runs holding both classes; both MD-S066 rows are paragraph lines with no list marker, so detectRuns never groups them and the invariant cannot fire.

traceability_state.reference_rows_rechecked: All 51 re-checked against sections 2 and 3: 26 list introducers, 1 bare label, 6 capability-boundary disclaimers, 8 purpose/rationale/pointer statements, 9 MD-S054 normalized-field fragments whose obligations are owned by the REQUIRED Mapping-rules siblings, and 1 permission granted to the promote phase. None states an unowned executable obligation.

secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.what: Re-running the B07 normalization stripped coverage_status and current_evidence_ids from 30 rows whose proof owner is another stage: 17 in MD-B09 bound to E-MD-B09-A002-001, 7 in MD-B08 bound to E-MD-B08-A001-001, and 6 in MD-B10 bound to E-MD-B10-A001-001.
secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.cause: The pass cleared current_evidence_ids and set coverage_status to NOT_ASSESSED for every row it examined, including the 88 rows it assigns to downstream proof owners. Under A001 this was inert because those stages were unproven; once they closed, the same code silently unbound their closed proof.
secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.introduced_by: This attempt. It was not a pre-existing condition of the matrix: the 30 rows were SATISFIED at HEAD 1b11d43 and were restored to SATISFIED before this record was finalised.
secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.how_it_escaped: All six governance gates and the full 1946-test suite passed while the 30 predicates were unbound. No gate verifies that a closed stage still holds its proof bindings, so a stage pass can silently unbind another stage and every green signal stays green.
secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.correction: The normalization now captures each row prior coverage_status and current_evidence_ids and restores them for any row whose proof owner is not MD-B07, and asserts that no row arriving SATISFIED under another owner leaves the pass unbound.
secondary_defect_found_and_corrected.verification: The full matrix was restored from HEAD and the normalization and binder re-applied deterministically. The resulting diff against HEAD is exactly one row, MD-S066-R0002. Per-stage SATISFIED counts are unchanged everywhere except MD-B07 (115 to 116). foreign_bindings_preserved reports 30.

proof.predicate: Token, cookie, and key material is masked wherever acquisition persists it.
proof.implementation: BackfillLifecycleOrchestrator::redactDiagnosticString() applied to error_sample, provider_error_sample, and sanitized_url on every checkpoint, summary, and failure path; SourceObservationRepository redaction on the envelope path.
proof.falsifiability_proof: redactDiagnosticString() was neutered to return its input unchanged. ApiBackfillLifecycleStaticGuardTest::test_source_acquisition_cache_is_slim_valid_json_and_sanitized failed at line 342 (assertStringNotContainsString('SECRET', $raw)). The source file was restored from git and verified byte-identical to HEAD. The obligation is enforced by a guard that can fail.
proof.foreign_binding_guard_falsifiability_pro: The two restore lines were removed and the normalization aborted with 'this pass unbound closed proof owned by another stage', naming all 30 rules with their owning stages. The assertion detects the unbinding itself, not a downstream symptom.
proof.scope_guard_falsifiability_proof: MD-S066-R0002 was removed from EXTERNAL_RULES and the normalization aborted with 'B07-owned rows never examined by this normalization: MD-S066-R0002'. The completeness assertion fires before the denominator check, so it detects the omission itself rather than its arithmetic symptom.

test_execution.delta_reason: ApiBackfillLifecycleStaticGuardTest joins the observation family because the checkpoint-cache masking path is a distinct surface the envelope tests do not cover.

residue_verdict.scope: The credential-masking predicate and the B07 normalization scope mechanism.
residue_verdict.basis: No application source, migration, configuration, or stored row was altered. The executable changes are a scope-completeness assertion, foreign-binding preservation plus its assertion, and attempt-awareness in the two B07 gates. All three guards are demonstrated falsifiable.

runtime_artifact_boundary.basis: The corrected predicate is proven by repository tests over the envelope and checkpoint-cache write paths; no runtime artifact was material to it.

open_items_after: The same scope-selection defect is structural, not specific to B07. Every stage normalization that selects its own scope from hand-curated lists can omit a row and still report success. Only MD-B07 is corrected here; the class is reported for the remaining stages.
MD-DEP-0004 remains OPEN_NON_BLOCKING for later stage-entry obligations.
The classification consistency gate still cannot see an obligation-bearing paragraph row filed as reference outside a mixed enumerated run.

No governance gate verifies that a closed stage still holds its proof bindings. This attempt unbound 30 closed predicates and every gate plus the full suite stayed green. Only the B07 normalization now guards against it; the other stage normalizations carry the same unguarded clearing code.
